name: Attribute Die: d4 to d6
text: Raise one Attribute Die from d4 to d6. Every Attribute starts at d4; this is the ordinary way to be good at something.

name: Attribute Die: d6 to d8
text: Raise one Attribute Die from d6 to d8. Skilled: a genuine specialist at the start of their career.

name: Attribute Die: d8 to d10
text: Raise one Attribute Die from d8 to d10. Expert before you have earned it: 17 Creation Points into a single Attribute, leaving almost nothing for anything else, and your four Ability Die Increases will have nowhere left to go on it.

name: Health Tier: Adept
text: 5 + your Vigor Die maximum. You solve problems before they reach melee.

name: Health Tier: Skirmisher
text: 7 + your Vigor Die maximum. Mobile fighters who pick their moments.

name: Health Tier: Frontline
text: 9 + your Vigor Die maximum. You hold the line and absorb what comes.

name: Health Tier: Bulwark
text: 11 + your Vigor Die maximum. You exist to be hit, and half your Creation Points say so.

name: Daily Reserve: +2 points
text: Add 2 points to your Daily Reserves, split across the four pools as you like. May be bought up to five times at creation (tunable).

name: Additional Trait
text: Choose one more Trait beyond the two creation grants free. Attribute-die gates still apply, and a weakness Trait still grants its own extra choice at no cost.

name: Task Specialty
text: Name a field you were trained in: Lockwork, Tracking, Field Medicine, Heraldry, Sailing, Forgework. When a Task falls squarely inside it, Upgrade your Attribute Die for that roll. The GM has final say on what a specialty covers, and a specialty never applies to an Impact Roll or a Save.

name: Access: Martial weapons
text: Wield martial weapon configurations without the out-of-access penalty (Downgraded Impact Pool and no Explosion Rider).

name: Access: Heavy weapons
text: Wield two-handed Heavy weapons, which add one bonus Impact Die on your first attack each turn. Requires Vigor d8.

name: Access: Light armor
text: Wear Light armor (+1 to +2 Vigor/Agility Defense) without Downgrading all four Attribute Dice.

name: Access: Medium armor
text: Wear Medium armor (+2 to +3 Vigor/Agility Defense) without penalty.

name: Access: Heavy armor
text: Wear Heavy armor (+3 to +5 Vigor/Agility Defense, Speed -5ft) without penalty. Requires Vigor d8.

name: Access: Arcane Vestments
text: Wear Arcane Vestments (+1 to +3 Focus/Resolve Defense) without penalty.

name: Access: Shields
text: Use a shield, unlocking the Intercept reaction against Explosions.

name: Access: Arcane Armaments
text: Cast through Wands, Rods, Orbs, Relics, Holy Symbols, Totems, Staves, and Spell Books, inheriting their Explosion Riders.

name: Spell School access
text: Gain access to one School of magic: its Tier 0 spells now, and its higher Tiers as your level unlocks them. Requires Focus d6. The equivalent Talent remains available from level 2 for anyone who would rather wait.

name: Coin: +50 gold
text: Start with 50 more gold. Creation already grants a weapon and armour you have access to plus an adventuring pack; this is for everything past that.

name: Veteran's Nerve
text: You have been frightened before and know the shape of it. Once per combat, Upgrade one Save you make.

name: Quick Hands
text: Everything you own is where your fingers expect it. Your Readied slots increase by 2, and once per turn drawing a Readied item is a Free effect instead of an Interaction.

name: Battle Sense
text: You read a room before it turns. Upgrade your Agility Die when rolling Initiative, and you cannot be surprised while conscious.

name: Stubborn
text: Things take hold of you slowly. Once per combat, when a condition would be applied to you, delay it until the end of your next turn instead.

name: Scavenger
text: You find things. Start with 100 extra gold and a Healer's Kit, and given an hour in any inhabited or ruined place you can turn up mundane supplies the party needs without a Task roll, at the GM's discretion.

name: Cantrip Touched
text: Something stuck. Learn one Tier 0 spell from any School without that School's access, and cast it as normal. Requires Focus d6. It never scales past Tier 0 unless you later gain the School.

name: Well-Traveled
text: You have been most places once. Gain one additional Task Specialty, and you can make yourself understood anywhere trade reaches.

name: Hard to Kill
text: You have been written off before. When you make a Vigor Save at 0 Hit Points, Upgrade it, and your first success stabilizes you instead of your third.
